title: ATM Helper
scenario: A stranger offers to help at an overseas ATM and says the machine is broken.

answers.A: Let the stranger insert or handle your card.
answers.B: Let the stranger explain the screen while you keep hold of the card.
answers.C: Cancel the transaction and use another bank ATM.
answers.D: Call the bank using the number on the ATM or your card.

explanation: Unsolicited ATM help can expose your PIN, card, or cash. Step away and use a bank-controlled channel.
proTip: A helpful stranger at an ATM is not your new financial adviser.
